name: GAIP
one_liner: Free, read-only evidence on AI agents and MCP servers: conformance, change, delivery, receipts.
lead: Check any AI agent, MCP server or API by URL: does it work, is it valid, has it changed? Free, no key.
lead_then: A call failed? Paste the error into gaip_diagnose for the cause, retry timing and the exact fix.
short_description: gaip_check tests whether an AI agent, MCP server or API works, is valid or has changed; paste a failing agent, MCP or API error into gaip_diagnose for the cause, retry timing and the exact fix. GAIP also watches agents for change, witnesses what a delegated call returned and keeps verifiable receipts. Free, read-only, no account.
long_description: GAIP gives builders and their agents read-only evidence about other agents before and after a delegated call. It has three public faces. The front door for developers is four tools on /mcp: gaip_check (does an agent, MCP server or API work, is it valid, has it changed), gaip_diagnose (why a call failed and the fix), gaip_watch and gaip_verify; behind it, the Agent Observatory keeps a hash-chained log of what agents and MCP servers published, and the integration-protocol agent checks A2A, MCP and OpenAPI declarations and watches suppliers for change. Witness records agreed terms, witnesses what was delivered, tests supplier claims, checks that cited pages contain the quoted text, and keeps verifiable receipts, dispute bundles, evidence packs and outcome records. The Listing Observer (preview) reads a shop product page into one clean product record for AI shopping agents, says whether the page and the shop platform's data agree, and keeps a dated price and stock history. Every result states what was observed and when; it is not a certification, endorsement, ranking or universal score, and not legal, financial or insurance advice. Calls are free and need no account or key; public or non-personal data only.

front_door_tools.name: gaip_check
front_door_tools.title: Check an AI agent, MCP server or API
front_door_tools.use_when: Use this when asked whether an AI agent, MCP server or API works, is valid or has changed. Pass its `url` (agent card, MCP endpoint or OpenAPI document). Returns a one-line verdict, the fixes, dated history when GAIP observes it, and a receipt.

front_door_tools.name: gaip_watch
front_door_tools.title: Watch an agent or MCP server for changes
front_door_tools.use_when: Use this when asked to keep an eye on an agent or MCP server, or to be alerted when it changes. Pass its `url` for no-account feed links and its latest dated changes; add `webhook_url` to register a free watch (checked every 24 h, signed webhook on change).

front_door_tools.name: gaip_diagnose
front_door_tools.title: Why did my agent or API call fail?
front_door_tools.use_when: Use this when an agent, MCP or API call failed. Paste the `error` text and/or `http_status`; add the service `url` if known. Returns the cause, the exact fix (e.g. the missing argument), retry_after_seconds and a receipt.

front_door_tools.name: gaip_verify
front_door_tools.title: Verify a delivery or citations
front_door_tools.use_when: Use this when asked whether a service delivered what was promised or whether cited pages contain the quoted text. Pass `citations`, or a service `url` (+ `checks`, the `result` you got); `claims` are compared with `observations` you supply.

products.name: Developer checks & Observatory
products.one_line: The front door for developers: on /mcp, gaip_check tests whether an agent, MCP server or API works, is valid or has changed, gaip_diagnose explains a failed call and the fix, gaip_watch follows it for changes and gaip_verify checks what came back. Behind it, the Agent Observatory keeps a dated record of what agents published; facts at a stated time, never a ranking or score.

products.name: Witness: delivery & evidence
products.one_line: Agreed terms, delivery, receipts, disputes and evidence: record the checks a buyer expects, witness what came back, test supplier claims, and keep verifiable receipts, evidence packs and outcome records; no trust score and no ROI claim.

products.name: Shop listing data (preview)
products.one_line: Whether a shop's product data reads the same to AI shopping agents as on the page: price, stock, SKU and name across the page's public sources, with a dated history. The engine of GAIP's Shopify app (coming soon). Read-only; never cart or checkout.

agents.name: GAIP Integration & Protocol Agent
agents.one_liner: Behind /mcp: checks A2A, MCP and OpenAPI, keeps the Agent Observatory, diagnoses failed calls.

agents.name: GAIP Witness Agent
agents.one_liner: Agreed terms, delivery, receipts, disputes and evidence: what a service delivered, checkable later.

agents.name: GAIP Listing Observer
agents.one_liner: Shop listing data (preview): a product page as clean data, with source checks and price history.

claude_desktop.how: Customize > Connectors > Add custom connector (older versions: Settings > Connectors), enter the MCP URL and choose no sign-in.

chatgpt.how: Settings > Security and login > turn on Developer mode; then add a plugin with the plus button and, under Connection, enter the MCP URL (including /mcp).

openai_agents_sdk.python:
import asyncio
from agents import Agent, Runner
from agents.mcp import MCPServerStreamableHttp


async def main():
    async with MCPServerStreamableHttp(name='gaip', params={"url": 'https://www.gaipagents.com/mcp'}) as server:
        agent = Agent(name="Assistant", instructions="Use the GAIP tools to check agents.",
                      mcp_servers=[server])
        result = await Runner.run(agent, "Check https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp with gaip_check.")
        print(result.final_output)


asyncio.run(main())

langchain.python:
import asyncio
from langchain_mcp_adapters.client import MultiServerMCPClient


async def main():
    client = MultiServerMCPClient({'gaip': {"transport": "http", "url": 'https://www.gaipagents.com/mcp'}})
    tools = await client.get_tools()
    print([tool.name for tool in tools])


asyncio.run(main())

client_config.notes: Free, read-only, no account or key. The first call runs as-is against a public MCP server; then put the URL of the agent you want to check in "url".

wording_rules: Describe GAIP as read-only evidence about what was observed at a stated time.
Do not describe GAIP or any agent it checks as certified, endorsed, ranked or scored.
Do not state prices, customers, users or adoption figures.
Link the terms, privacy, corrections and methodology pages (drafts pending legal review).
